instruction: Set up dependent drop-down lists so that selecting a category in 'Form'!B2 automatically restricts the options in 'Form'!C2 to only the subcategories for that category using the data in the 'Account' sheet. Create a helper 'Lists' sheet that contains unique categories across row 1 and their subcategories listed beneath each category. Define a named range 'Categories' for the categories row and a named range for each category's subcategory list. Configure data validation so 'Form'!B2 uses =Categories and 'Form'!C2 uses =INDIRECT(SUBSTITUTE(B2, " " , "_")) to reference the matching list.
